caribbean.headline: Roatan Faces Heavy Rain, Strong Winds Today
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan is experiencing 23 kt winds, 5.4 ft waves, and 75% rain probability with a dominant ENE swell period of 9 s. Bimini is seeing 26 kt winds.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean Ports Brace for Moderate Winds and Moderate Rain
mediterranean.paragraph: Naples is experiencing maximum winds of 9 knots, wave heights up to 3.8 feet, a dominant SW swell period of 5 seconds, and a 50% rain probability. I note that Marseille, the runner‑up port, is seeing maximum winds of 18 knots.
